title: Croissants Amazing Expansion Pack!
description: This project will include so much new tools, armor, ores, enchantments, advancements, and many more! -Currently this is an alpha and is not finished. Expect MANY BUGS-
body:
Croissants Amazing Expansion Pack

Croissants Amazing Expansion Pack is a content-rich addon for Minecraft that expands progression with new ores, tools, foods, armor sets, and enchantments, all designed to blend naturally into vanilla gameplay while giving players fresh goals to chase.

✨ Features
🪨 New Ores & Materials

-Multiple new ore types that generate throughout the world

-Each ore includes unique smelting, crafting, and upgrade paths

-Custom materials with balanced stats that fit into the vanilla progression system

🔧 New Tools

-Full tool sets crafted from the new materials

-Tools come with special abilities or stat bonuses, depending on their tier

-Designed to feel powerful without breaking the balance of the game

🛡️ New Armor Sets

-New armor tiers that offer improved defense, special traits, or resistance bonuses

-Fully textured armor sets made to match the vanilla Minecraft style

-Options for players who want late-game goals beyond Netherite

📘 New Enchantments

-A variety of custom enchantments for weapons, tools, and armor

-Enchants are balanced, with clear strengths and strategic use-cases

-Adds more depth to enchanting and late-game item progression

🍇 New Foods

-Many new delicious foods for you to munch on !

-All foods give different hunger amounts and some even special buffs!

🌍 Designed for Vanilla-Friendly Play

Everything is crafted to blend with the base game

No overpowered gear or confusing systems—just smooth progression

Ideal for survival worlds, modpacks, SMPs, or progression-focused players

🧭 Why Download This Pack?

Adds meaningful progression past vanilla gear

Expands gameplay without unnecessary complexity

Perfect for players who want more tools, more armor, more enchantments, and more exploration rewards

Whether you're building a modpack or enhancing your own world, Croissants Amazing Expansion Pack brings new depth and variety while staying faithful to Minecraft’s design.
